notes: Identity assessment: supplied text is a primary Final Report, December 23, 2020, titled Replication of a Research Claim from Kang et al. (2009), from Journal of Experimental Social Psychology. It names replication team Marco Jürgen Held & Astrid Schütz, research scientist Nicholas Fox, project Kang_JournExpSocPsych_2009_rpq - Held – Direct Replication – 308, OSF hd3vf and download ftv7q. These project/team/source identifiers correspond to the supplied replication reference, although its 2025 date and fuller author list differ from this report. The cited original title and DOI match the supplied original reference. This is a report, not a preregistration or abstract. No PDF was supplied. Only es_value_r is assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Target correspondence cannot be established: the input supplies no replication locator, outcome description or study identifier. The report contains several paired comparisons compatible with a dependent-sample effect. Its primary SCORE focal claim is White old versus young targets in the angry-to-happy transition, printed d = -0.37, t(54) = -2.74, p = .008 (pp. 2, 6); this remains a candidate rather than an assigned row match. Additional printed paired-test d candidates: angry-to-happy Black targets 0.38 (p. 6); happy-to-angry Black targets -0.35 (p. 6); angry-to-neutral White targets -0.36 (p. 6); neutral-to-angry White targets 0.33 and Black targets 0.64 (p. 7); happy-to-neutral White targets 0.44 and Black targets -0.36 (p. 7); neutral-to-happy Black targets -0.84 (p. 7). Metric is printed as d; no conversion or assumption of a specific standardizer is made. No candidate is promoted to es.value without row-specific correspondence.
